label: INTERNAL REVIEW
travelingCohort: Nonlocal participants and association/program personnel from the naval ship-maintenance and modernization community. The recurring community and historical hotel use are evidenced; the 2027 traveling subset is inferred and not yet quantified.
demandSignal: The convention center lists ASNE's Fleet Maintenance & Modernization Symposium for September 14–16, 2027. ASNE identifies FMMS as a national naval-maintenance community gathering alternating between Hampton Roads and San Diego, and its 2026 edition demonstrates an established hotel-block model. Applying overnight demand to the 2027 edition remains an inference.
whyWyndhamFits: The announced 2027 venue is approximately one mile from the Wyndham's North Harbor Drive location. A defined association, speaker or participant sub-block could fit its convention-adjacent positioning. Any allocation must be screened against the 30–250-room planning band; the entire event's attendance or lodging volume is not estimated.
sourcingStatus: No 2027 hotel roster, room commitment or hotel RFP was found. ASNE's 2026 Virginia Beach edition had official multi-hotel blocks, which establishes historical lodging-program practice only; it does not establish 2027 suppliers, availability or overflow.
recommendedFirstAction: Reach Madeline Foresman (asnehq@navalengineers.org) regarding American Society of Naval Engineers lodging/meeting needs for Wyndham San Diego Bayside.
specificQuestion: Are you still evaluating downtown / bayfront lodging or meeting space for this cohort, and what peak room nights / dates should we check?

confirmed_facts: The venue calendar lists FMMS for September 14–16, 2027 at San Diego Convention Center.
ASNE identifies FMMS as an annual event alternating between Hampton Roads and San Diego.
The 2026 Virginia Beach edition had official hotel room blocks.
The San Diego chapter publishes a public ASNE contact email.

inferences: The recurring national community and prior hotel-block practice make nonlocal overnight participation in San Diego plausible.
An association-controlled or participant sub-block is a potential angle, not an established requirement.

otherHotel: Not publicly confirmed for 2027. The hotels disclosed for the 2026 Virginia Beach event must not be transferred to the San Diego edition.
